data_fields.name: winner damage floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 25 credit when winner damage is above 0 and below 25

data_fields.name: level 2 threshold and step
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 points to level 2; step i times 10 for level i+1

best_idea: Per-fight progression from server-side totals: credit damage up to a cap, add a flat win bonus, turn total points into levels with a triangular table, and grant one upgrade for each level crossed.
decision_why: Take the capped damage credit, the win bonus and the one-upgrade-per-level-crossed rule as the server-side per-fight award, with the cap and bonus as encounter data; keep the triangular level table as an engine constant; defer the rating delta (a ranked-ladder idea, and a second ledger) and do not copy the zero-damage winner case without a decision.
acceptance: A server test: a winning duel with 40 damage to the opponent credits 35 points (25 plus 10); a losing duel with 40 damage credits 25; a player at 25 points (level 2) who wins with 5 damage is credited 25 by the worker floor, moves to 60 points (level 4), and gains 2 upgrades.
